question: Which region contributed most to the decline from June to July?
sql: WITH base AS (SELECT regions.region_name AS region, SUM(revenue) AS v FROM orders JOIN regions ON regions.region_id = orders.region_id WHERE order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY regions.region_name), targ AS (SELECT regions.region_name AS region, SUM(revenue) AS v FROM orders JOIN regions ON regions.region_id = orders.region_id WHERE order_date >= '2026-07-01' AND order_date < '2026-08-01' GROUP BY regions.region_name), merged AS (SELECT base.region AS region, base.v AS base_value, COALESCE(targ.v, 0) AS target_value FROM base LEFT JOIN targ ON base.region = targ.region UNION ALL SELECT targ.region AS region, 0 AS base_value, targ.v AS target_value FROM targ LEFT JOIN base ON base.region = targ.region WHERE base.region IS NULL) SELECT region, base_value, target_value, (target_value - base_value) AS delta FROM merged ORDER BY delta ASC
explanation:
KPI: total_revenue ≡ SUM(revenue) · Grouped by: region_name · Contribution: 2026-06 → 2026-07 across region_name · Dataset: orders

Total Revenue changed from 454,994.41 to 202,536.65 (-252,457.76, -55.5%) between 2026-06 and 2026-07. Largest decline came from region_name 'East' (-126,371.18, -80.6%).

question: Which customers have revenue above average but profit below average?
sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT customers.customer_name AS customer, SUM(revenue) AS m1, SUM(revenue-cost) AS m2 FROM orders JOIN customers ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY customers.customer_name) SELECT customer, m1, m2 FROM agg WHERE m1 > (SELECT AVG(m1) FROM agg) AND m2 < (SELECT AVG(m2) FROM agg) ORDER BY m1 DESC
explanation:
KPI: total_revenue ≡ SUM(revenue) · Grouped by: customer_name · Dataset: orders
